inputs.name: diffusion check point
inputs.cite: RESULTS B0.4 row (quoted in record M-601)

day.reading: (2/s) ln(2Ne s) at the empirical s gives 14,648-76,051 generations; d = 0.80 rescales to 18,310 and 50,000
day.holds: every printed value reproduces; the diffusion mean is longer still (28,898 at Ne = 1e4), so the formula errs in the direction that helps the critics, not Day; the all-fixation average is worse, as L72 says (35,662)

critic.reading: Ne scaling already handles overlap (Hancock); dividing by d is open; the formula is applied outside its domain
critic.holds: 2Ne s = 3 at Ne = 1e4, where the large-Ne s formula is off by 2.0x; feeding a mixture mean s into a sweep formula times an allele that does not exist (87.5% fix neutrally in 4Ne, 12.5% sweep in about 5,300-7,400); the d correction is M-013/M-107

notes: All printed arithmetic reproduces. The diffusion integral is the standard Kimura-Ohta conditional fixation time with Ne = N, from one new copy; it reproduces B0.4's 8,480 and the neutral 4Ne, and matches the (2/s)(ln 4Ns + gamma) asymptote within 24 generations at Ne = 1e6. It shows the printed (2/s) ln(2Ne s) values understate the conditional mean by 1.2-2.0x at s = 1.5e-4. This does not move Day's direction: the times are longer, not shorter. The division by d is recorded as arithmetic only.
